wave_one_hand.role: signal: rendered turned 0.8 rad toward the viewer (right sheet +0.8, left -0.8) so the raised hand shows beside the head, not at the cap

roll_behind_cover.needs: a low cover she dives over: sandbag wall or crate at most 0.69 m (36 px); segment 1 (0-2.0 s) is the dive, its lowest body pixel 27-40 px over the ground in frames 6-12; segment 2 (2.1-3.5 s) the landing and the crouch behind it. To hide without a prop use crouch_look_around.

prone_crawl_back.role: belly crawl backward (Crawl Backward, loop; negative speed)

crawl_and_look_back.role: crawls on all fours and twice looks back over the shoulder (one-shot, 6.9 s)

crawl.role: crawl on all fours, loop (the steady stretch 3.3-4.95 s of Crawl and Look Back, loop end fitted)

step_turn_left.role: sneak turn: a quiet 90-degree step turn (right sheet: away from the viewer, left sheet: toward the viewer)
step_turn_left.note: faced on the start pose (she starts bladed 0.75 rad toward the viewer in the rig)

step_turn_back.role: sneak turn-back: the step turn chained twice into a 180-degree turn (as the cast's turn_back)

cautious_crouch_walk_backward.role: hide: backs into cover in a crouch, the front arm held straight out at shoulder height for balance and the back hand low behind (the same arm shape as her pass-1 cautious_crouch_walk_forward); loop, negative speed

kneel_to_stand.role: hide crouch: gets up from one knee behind cover

lean_out.role: peek: leans the upper body out along the facing past a cover edge and pulls back (head socket +17 px right / -19 px left at the furthest, frame 4)
lean_out.note: Stand Dodge turned 1.2 rad (face -1.2): the right sheet shows her back three-quarters (pressed to the cover), the left her front three-quarters; the library has no peek action. From the idle it pops (she is turned ~70 degrees in frame 0): enter it through step_turn_left and leave through step_turn_left played backwards (prev / next)

prev.why: step_turn_left ends turned away from the facing (right sheet: her back to the viewer, left: her front), lean_out starts three-quarters turned the same way: a small yaw step (~20 degrees) instead of the pop from the idle; draw lean_out with its anchor y = the previous anchor y - dy_px

next.why: lean_out ends on its start pose; play step_turn_left backwards (its frames last -> first, root_px negated) to turn back to the facing, then idle; dy_px against step_turn_left's last frame

prone_crawl.role: belly crawl forward, head first: prone_crawl_back played in reverse (the same atlas rects)

kneel_down.role: hide crouch: drops to one knee behind cover (kneel_to_stand frames 15 -> 0, played in reverse)

next.why: ends on kneel_to_stand's first frame (the same atlas rect): hold this last frame for as long as she hides ('any'), then play kneel_to_stand; dy_px 0. Do not chain it into crouch_look_around (p2e): that is a wide two-foot squat, from one knee it pops

p2e_fix: p2e fix round: every clip re-rendered from GLB copies whose texture has the jacket belt (y 1.036-1.074 m, dark texels) painted leather (p2e/fix/texpaint.py) so it reads as one wood-ramp row at the waist, and with the face skin ramp skinM / skinM / skinL / skinL / skinL (no near-black skinS step: the shadowed jaw and the under-brim pixels of the right facing read as a beard). Mesh, rig, clips and the 3D kit GLB are unchanged.
p2f: pass 2, job p2f (the last credits): the rows with pack "p2f" are a further Meshy action pack on the same rig (lib/resistance_courier/final_anim_p2f.json), rendered with the pass-1/2 renderer (char/cfg_p2f.py) and appended under the earlier rows; they carry speed / root_px (px along the facing, the root motion taken out), ground snap (ay on the lowest opaque row) and role / needs / next / note / prop metadata; reverse_of = a row played backwards from the same rects
